name: Webmius
description: Web-based SSH connection manager built with Flask, Socket.IO and React.

SECRET_KEY.description: Flask session signing key. Auto-generated on deploy.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Key used to encrypt stored SSH credentials at rest. Auto-generated on deploy.

FRONTEND_URL.description: Public URL of this app, e.g. https://your-app-abc123.herokuapp.com (used in emailed links such as password reset). Leave empty if not using email features.
